sections.title: CCTV Surveillance Systems
sections.contentSnippet:
Design, installation, and maintenance of high-definition IP and hybrid CCTV systems, compliant with SIRA and local regulations. We provide advanced features such as video analytics, ANPR, facial recognition, and central monitoring integration
Secure and manage your premises with card-based, biometric, or mobile-based access solutions. Our systems integrate seamlessly with HR tools, time attendance, and visitor management systems to enhance both security and productivity.
We deploy robust vehicle and pedestrian access control systems including boom barriers, sliding gates, and speed gates—integrated with license plate recognition and visitor management platforms.

Facilities Manager, Dubai Residential Tower
"QuantaSec’s team was highly professional from day one. Their CCTV and access control installation was seamless, and their AMC support keeps everything running flawlessly."
Operations Head, Retail Mall Group
"We needed a SIRA-compliant upgrade across multiple malls. QuantaSec delivered ahead of schedule with zero downtime. Their expertise in ELV systems is unmatched."
IT Director, Commercial Complex
"Their centralized monitoring system helped us unify all building security under one dashboard. It’s efficient, smart, and exactly what we needed."
